title: Nelson Tasman — Centre of New Zealand

facts.fact: The landmark marks a central geodetic survey point used in the1870s.
It is an uphill walk to views of Nelson and Tasman Bay, not an accessible flat city path.
Botanical Reserve can be accessed via a blue footbridge near Hardy Street or Tory/Milton Streets.
Views include Tasman Bay; the tourism timing is an estimate dependent on pace.
